outcome: Type of milk consumed by infants
Association between breastfeeding, type of delivery, and history of prematurity
cohort: 4929 infants in the first year of life seen in private pediatric practices in Brazil
finding: While breastfeeding was the sole milk source for more than half of the infants before 180 days of life, cesarean delivery and pre-term birth history were negatively associated with exclusive breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Infants born via vaginal delivery were more likely to be exclusively breastfed in the first six months of life compared to infants born via cesarean delivery.
